page.layout: One title page, one column, centred. Woodcut ornament below the text block. Imprint line and date at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (a cornucopia with a head and foliage) between the author line and the imprint; no text. Long s is printed as a plain s in "asperis", "scientias", "Spina". Date printed in the old reversed-C form, transcribed as MDXCI. The "AD" at the start of the Henricum line is partly cut off at the left edge in the scan, so it is shown as printed.
